items.title: Dollar Wraps Best Month Since March on Fed’s Inflation Fight
items.summary: The dollar wrapped up its best month since March after the Federal Reserve’s renewed focus on taming inflation pushed interest-rate expectations and US bond yields higher.

items.title: Fed watchdog finds no crimes in $2.4B building renovation, only mismanagement
items.summary: The Federal Reserve’s internal watchdog says that the central bank has broadly mismanaged an expansive building renovation project but did not find any criminal violations, as alleged by Trump administration prosecutors. The Fed’s inspector general said Wednesday that a variety of missteps by its Board of Governors inflated the cost of the $2.4 billion renovation. The board did not secure a comprehensive cost estimate at the beginning of the project, nor did it nail down a maximum overall cost, a step that could have forced the building contractor to absorb the impact of inflation, the IG said in a 120-page report. Prices spiked after construction began in 2022.

items.title: Fed's preferred inflation gauge cooler than expected, likely delaying rate hike to December
items.summary: The Federal Reserve’s preferred inflation gauge in August came in cooler than expected -- likely delaying another interest-rate hike until December.

items.title: US dollar retreats after softer-than-expected inflation data
items.summary: The dollar faced a downturn against key currencies following unexpected inflation results from the US. The US Commerce Department reported the Personal Consumption Expenditures Price Index increased by merely 0.3% last month, contrary to economists' forecasts of 0.4%. This shift affected market predictions about Federal Reserve interest rate adjustments, resulting in lower US Treasury yields.

items.title: Wall Street closes in on a winning September following an encouraging update on inflation
items.summary: U.S. stock indexes are holding firmer following a potentially encouraging update on inflation. The S&P 500 rose 0.5% Wednesday and is close to finishing September with a small gain instead of a loss. The Dow Jones Industrial Average dipped 10 points, and the Nasdaq composite rose 0.9%. They got some support from an easing for short-term Treasury yields after the latest inflation update. Traders are paring bets that the Federal Reserve will increase its main interest rate next month to curtail inflation. But longer-term yields were stronger following the latest signals that the U.S. economy continues to grow.

items.title: Why is gold price rising today? Gold prices move higher as markets assess US inflation data and Federal Reserve rate expectations
items.summary: Gold price is witnessing a steady spike on Wednesday. Spot gold jumped 0.2% to $4,188.17 an ounce, while US gold futures gained 1% to $4,219.90. The gold price is still more than 5% down for the month as higher interest rate expectations continue to put pressure on the precious metal.
